preconditions: Build BFSOne_Mobile_App from the pinned commit carrying the debug-only -of-evidence-gallery launch argument (Compose Multiplatform 1.9.0) and install it on the dedicated simulator.
The argument opens the Design System gallery offline: no login and no request to api.beelogistics.com. Never log in or submit anything in this app.

assertions.claim: The screen shows a Sign in button.
